topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, connects it to histopathology practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Assays of Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: They trace how the historical study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental methods for testing cellular transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, Tumor Suppressors, and Mutation Types
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the definitions, mutational mechanisms, and cell-cycle effects that distinguish oncogenes from tumor suppressor genes.

topics.label: Genetic Instability and Multi-Step Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the molecular causes and cellular outcomes of genomic instability and explain how it drives multi-step tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Predispositions to Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how inherited germline mutations predispose individuals to cancer and accelerate tumorigenesis through the two-hit paradigm.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Reading Recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer wraps up the lecture, offers Easter reading recommendations, and previews the next session.
